name: home-assistant-connector
description: Home Assistant connector with sensor-only default access, per-category disabled/enabled/PIN policy, and a companion Anna settings app preview. PIN actions are blocked until secure approval is implemented.
author: Eric McCormick

credentials.name: HA_URL
credentials.description: HTTPS base URL, e.g. https://example.home:8123. No path or slash after port.

credentials.name: HA_TOKEN
credentials.description: Create in Home Assistant profile. Never share in a conversation.

credentials.name: HA_ALLOW_LOCAL_HTTP
credentials.description: Set true ONLY on a trusted local Agent/LAN. Token will travel unencrypted.

credentials.name: HA_POLICY_JSON
credentials.description: Paste JSON exported from the Home Assistant Control App. Sensor reading always enabled; other actions disabled by default. PIN mode blocks actions until approval support is implemented.

credentials.name: HA_APPROVAL_PIN
credentials.description: Reserved for a future verified approval flow; do not rely on this field yet. PIN-protected operations currently fail closed.

tools.name: get_permissions
tools.description: Read active Home Assistant Executa permission modes (never exposes URL, token or PIN); preview includes enabled/disabled/PIN values. PIN modes currently block execution.

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Verify the configured Home Assistant URL/token and report server name and version. Does not expose credentials.

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Read a sensor or binary_sensor state without additional approval; other domains require other_read permission.

parameters.name: entity_id
parameters.description: Home Assistant entity id such as sensor.temperature

tools.name: list_states
tools.description: List sensors and binary sensors by default. Other entity domains require the other_read policy to be enabled.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: Optional entity domain such as light, sensor, or switch

tools.name: converse
tools.description: Send a request to Home Assistant Assist only when the assist permission is enabled. Assist can operate devices and is NOT protected from indirect effects.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Optional Home Assistant conversation agent ID

tools.name: call_service
tools.description: Control an explicitly permitted device category. Disabled by default; PIN mode is fail-closed pending secure approval support. NEVER infer user consent from this tool.

tools.name: fire_event
tools.description: Fire an event only when event permission is enabled. Disabled by default; PIN mode fails closed.
